newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly steady, gas oil surges.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly steady, gas oil surges.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly steady on Thursday, except gas oil which rallied another $7.00 per tonne, dealers said.
Gasoline was steady to firmer but thin. Naphtha drifted sideways with futures, but premiums were still strong.
Gas oil jumped $7.00 per tonne on very strong demand, especially for European low sulphur diesel. Premiums for this grade were talked up to October +$20.00 cif NWE.
Fuel oil was steady, but low sulphur strainght-run was oversupplied.
